integration_decision.name: FAIL_CLOSED_CHILD_A_PAUSE_TIMEOUT_AND_CROSS_FILE_PHASE_WITNESS
integration_decision.source_inference: runner.run_once builds from a loaded archive snapshot, then writes latest.json, audit_latest.json, and finally anata_latest.json independently; ArchiveWriterLock protects individual archive operations, not this publication sequence. A paused before its final anata_latest.json write has already written its two other files. B can publish a newer handoff while A is paused; resuming A could overwrite only anata_latest.json, yielding stale/mixed generations. Risk is NOT reproduced.
integration_decision.harness_gap: Earlier child-A Event.wait(timeout) contract did not specify fail-closed handling of wait returning False. If A silently resumes on timeout before B's positive publication witness, a diagnostic can misattribute the interleaving or falsely pass. Distinguish A_PAUSE_TIMEOUT from stale-overwrite RED.
runnable_no_network_contract: Use exact public SHA in an authorized disposable checkout, tmp_path, T=1700000000000, one importable top-level target per child, multiprocessing.get_context('spawn'), and existing valid PIT rowB fixture.

Child A patches runner.atomic_write_json inside spawned process only; intercept destination.name=='anata_latest.json'; emit A_PAUSED after earlier latest/audit writes, then if not release_A.wait(timeout=bounded_seconds): emit A_PAUSE_TIMEOUT and raise TimeoutError WITHOUT writing anata_latest.json. Restore alias in finally. Never treat timeout self-release as PASS or RED.

Parent waits for A_PAUSED, launches independent APPENDER, verifies append success and durable archive rowB, then launches unpatched child B. Require B completed run_once, B_PUBLISHED_ROW_B and persisted anata_latest.json containing rowB while A is still paused and before release_A; capture latest/audit/anata hashes and archive identity.

Parent releases A only after the positive B-before-A witness, using finally to release/terminate/join every child with bounded waits. If child A timed out or B was blocked without a positive phase/serialization witness, result INCONCLUSIVE, not PASS/RED.

After A completion, verify archive still has rowB and compare persisted anata_latest.json against B-before-A witness; missing rowB after A is RED stale overwrite even if recovery C later restores it. Record latest/audit/anata hashes as a mixed-generation diagnostic; do not claim three-file atomicity.

If a future whole-run serialization lock prevents B publication, require explicit phase/lock witness and B post-release publication to classify SERIALIZED_PASS; a mere B timeout is INCONCLUSIVE. Preserve exitcodes, timestamps, stdout/stderr, test outputs and diff-check diagnostics.
